extends Node
signal stat_changed(name: String, value: float)
signal money_changed(value: float)
signal mission_changed(id: String, state: String)
signal blackout_changed(active: bool)

var money: float = 12.0
var water: float = 48.0
var fuel: float = 42.0
var energy: float = 95.0
var mood: float = 72.0

var current_vehicle_id: String = ""
var current_district: String = "tunis_centre"
var blackout_active: bool = false
var fuel_shortage: bool = false
var water_shortage: bool = false

var missions := {
    "find_water": "active",
    "find_fuel": "locked",
    "find_job": "locked",
    "survive_blackout": "locked",
    "reach_port": "locked",
    "boat_stage": "locked",
}

func reset() -> void:
    money = 12.0
    water = 48.0
    fuel = 42.0
    energy = 95.0
    mood = 72.0
    current_vehicle_id = ""
    current_district = "tunis_centre"
    blackout_active = false
    fuel_shortage = false
    water_shortage = false
    missions = {
        "find_water": "active",
        "find_fuel": "locked",
        "find_job": "locked",
        "survive_blackout": "locked",
        "reach_port": "locked",
        "boat_stage": "locked",
    }

func set_stat(name: String, value: float) -> void:
    if name not in ["water","fuel","energy","mood"]:
        return
    var v := clampf(value, 0.0, 100.0)
    set(name, v)
    stat_changed.emit(name, v)

func add_money(amount: float) -> void:
    money = maxf(0.0, money + amount)
    money_changed.emit(money)

func set_mission(id: String, state: String) -> void:
    if not missions.has(id):
        return
    missions[id] = state
    mission_changed.emit(id, state)

func is_completed(id: String) -> bool:
    return missions.get(id, "") == "completed"

func set_blackout(active: bool) -> void:
    if blackout_active == active:
        return
    blackout_active = active
    blackout_changed.emit(active)

extends Node

const DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION := 1
const HEALTH_PATH := "user://hayat_tounes_health.json"
const HEALTH_TEMP_PATH := "user://hayat_tounes_health.tmp"
const HEALTH_BACKUP_PATH := "user://hayat_tounes_health.backup.json"
const EVENT_PATH := "user://hayat_tounes_runtime_events.jsonl"
const EVENT_BACKUP_PATH := "user://hayat_tounes_runtime_events.previous.jsonl"
const SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS := 5.0
const MAX_HEALTH_FILE_BYTES := 64 * 1024
const MAX_EVENT_FILE_BYTES := 262144
const MAX_EVENT_RECORD_BYTES := 32 * 1024

var session_id: String = ""
var started_unix: int = 0
var sample_elapsed := 0.0
var min_fps := 1000000.0
var max_fps := 0.0
var fps_sum := 0.0
var fps_samples := 0
var last_error: String = ""
var last_save_ok := true
var last_save_reason := "none"
var session_safe_mode := false
var previous_session_unclean := false
var session_crash_count := 0
var session_recovery_reason := "none"
var session_marker_source := "none"

func _ready() -> void:
    process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
    started_unix = int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system())
    session_id = "%s-%s" % [started_unix, randi()]
    record_event("session_start", {
        "engine": Engine.get_version_info().get("string", "unknown"),
        "platform": OS.get_name(),
        "locale": OS.get_locale(),
        "processor_count": OS.get_processor_count()
    })
    write_health_snapshot("startup")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    sample_elapsed += delta
    if sample_elapsed < SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        return
    sample_elapsed = 0.0
    var fps := float(Engine.get_frames_per_second())
    min_fps = minf(min_fps, fps)
    max_fps = maxf(max_fps, fps)
    fps_sum += fps
    fps_samples += 1
    write_health_snapshot("periodic")

func record_event(event_name: String, fields: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
    var row := {
        "schema": DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "unix": int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),
        "event": event_name,
        "fields": fields
    }
    var encoded := JSON.stringify(row) + "\n"
    var encoded_bytes := encoded.to_utf8_buffer().size()
    if encoded_bytes > MAX_EVENT_RECORD_BYTES:
        row = {
            "schema": DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "session_id": session_id,
            "unix": int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),
            "event": "diagnostic_event_dropped",
            "fields": {
                "original_event": event_name,
                "encoded_bytes": encoded_bytes,
                "max_record_bytes": MAX_EVENT_RECORD_BYTES
            }
        }
        encoded = JSON.stringify(row) + "\n"
        encoded_bytes = encoded.to_utf8_buffer().size()
        last_error = "event_record_too_large"
    _rotate_event_log_if_needed(encoded.to_utf8_buffer().size())
    var file := FileAccess.open(EVENT_PATH, FileAccess.READ_WRITE)
    if file == null:
        file = FileAccess.open(EVENT_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
    if file == null:
        last_error = "event_log_open_failed"
        return
    file.seek_end()
    file.store_string(encoded)
    file.flush()
    if file.get_error() != OK:
        last_error = "event_log_write_failed"

func note_save_result(ok: bool, reason: String) -> void:
    last_save_ok = ok
    last_save_reason = reason
    record_event("save_result", {"ok": ok, "reason": reason})
    write_health_snapshot("save_result")

func note_session_guard(unclean: bool, crash_count: int, safe_mode: bool, reason: String, marker_source: String = "none") -> void:
    previous_session_unclean = unclean
    session_crash_count = maxi(0, crash_count)
    session_safe_mode = safe_mode
    session_recovery_reason = reason
    session_marker_source = marker_source
    record_event("session_guard", {
        "previous_session_unclean": unclean,
        "crash_count": session_crash_count,
        "safe_mode": safe_mode,
        "reason": reason,
        "marker_source": marker_source
    })
    write_health_snapshot("session_guard")

func note_world_ready(using_real_osm: bool, vehicle_count: int) -> void:
    record_event("world_ready", {
        "using_real_osm": using_real_osm,
        "vehicle_count": vehicle_count,
        "node_count": int(Performance.get_monitor(Performance.OBJECT_NODE_COUNT))
    })
    write_health_snapshot("world_ready")

func build_health_snapshot(reason: String = "manual") -> Dictionary:
    var fps := float(Engine.get_frames_per_second())
    var average_fps := fps_sum / float(fps_samples) if fps_samples > 0 else fps
    return {
        "schema_version": DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "session_id": session_id,
        "reason": reason,
        "started_unix": started_unix,
        "captured_unix": int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()),
        "uptime_seconds": maxf(0.0, Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0),
        "engine_version": Engine.get_version_info().get("string", "unknown"),
        "platform": OS.get_name(),
